conbody.p: Do not share the closing workbook with anyone outside the finance team, even for a quick review.
Ask the controller to take care of any posting that the period close report marks as late or unbalanced.
Call the ledger help line on 800-555-0100 if the close fails twice for the same period and the same company.
Attach the signed receipts to the closing case so that the auditor can check them before the period is locked.
